headline: First release of Iman, focused on reliable prayer reminders, a customizable widget, and a simple Quran-first experience.
highlights: Prayer and pre-prayer reminders use one saved schedule and stronger alarms, with a sound choice for each prayer.
The home-screen widget has show/hide options, shows only the five prayers, and has a customizable active-prayer color.
The Quran reader has search, bookmarks, an exit reminder, and the QuranIndoPak script font.

sections.title: Added
items: Per-prayer sound selection (Default, Adhan, Takbir, Silent), including the pre-prayer reminder.
Quran search, a bookmark list with sorting and delete confirmation, and an exit reminder for unbookmarked ayahs.
Retry option when ayah audio fails to load.

sections.title: Improved
items: Home screen simplified: removed events, mosque directory, the sunrise/sunset arc, and prayer row markers.
Qibla compass is steadier and corrects for magnetic declination.
Pull-to-refresh now updates your GPS location, the widget, and your reminders.

sections.title: Changed
items: Study now contains only the Holy Quran; the Pray section, Learn, and Hadith were removed.
The widget shows prayer times in the 24-hour format.
